# wowforevertalents.com fixtures (#458)

Pages saved from https://wowforevertalents.com/ on 2026-10-31 (client build 1.60.1.70707 plus the server hotfixes of
30 October). The site states no license; the owner decided to use it as the rank-text source with credit (#458).

- `druid.html`, `priest.html`: class pages (talent links and the calculator grid; the priest page names its third tree "Shadow Magic").
- `druid-talents-genesis.html`, `druid-talents-lacerate.html`, `paladin-talents-champion-of-the-light.html`,
  `mage-talents-incineration.html`: talent pages. Incineration also carries the Classic Era wording in a second list.
